# Day-ahead completions: single test evaluation (generated by `scripts/run_dayahead_ext.py`; part P2 of the completion batch)

Git commit `31e071dfdd`. Same task, samples and rules as the day-ahead model; scenario A unless labelled. MAE in MW over all (day, hour) samples (8,611). Models fitted on the training period only with the validation-chosen configuration.

| model | test MAE (MW) |
|---|---:|
| XGBoost S4, pooled (day-ahead model) | 4,120 |
| ridge (day-ahead model) | 4,826 |
| LSTM L4, pooled (day-ahead model) | 4,634 |
| XGBoost S4, one model per target hour | 4,290 |
| LSTM L1 (history + calendar), pooled | 4,338 |

## Feature ablation of the pooled XGBoost (hyper-parameters of the day-ahead S4 model)

| feature set | MAE (MW) |
|---|---:|
| S0_history | 4,621 |
| S1_calendar | 4,203 |
| S2_holidays | 4,130 |
| S3_weatherA | 4,065 |
| S5_oracle_B (oracle weather, upper bound) | 4,013 |
| S6_forecastC (archived temperature forecasts; issue times unverified) | 4,060 |
| S4_full_A (the day-ahead model) | 4,120 |

## XGBoost quantile regression (raw 5%-95% interval)

Raw coverage 83.7% (nominal 90%), mean width 15,378 MW; conformal calibration and comparison with the other interval methods are in the analysis report.

Run time 499 s.
